sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The Wedge is a Black Division Boss in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- The number of followers The Wedge has on Icebreaker depends on the number of players in the raid:
  - 3 with 1 player
  - 4 with 2 players
  - 6 with 3 players
- The Wedge and and his 3-6 followers have different health values than PMCs and Scavs.

The Wedge:
| Stats |
| Head: 70; Thorax: 170; Stomach: 140; Arms: 120 each; Legs: 130 each; Total: 880 |

Follower:
| Stats |
| Head: 70; Thorax: 170; Stomach: 140; Arms: 120 each; Legs: 130 each; Total: 880 |

- Instead of the typical 4 single slot pockets, he has 5 double slot pockets, bringing their total space to 10 slots.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text:
- The Wedge's Spiritus Systems LV-119 Plate Carrier (MultiCam Black) needs to be obtained for the quest A Wedge Between Us.
- 4 of The Wedge's guards need to be killed for the quest A Wedge Between Us.

sections.heading: Location
sections.text: The Wedge can be found in the gym on level 3 of Icebreaker.

sections.heading: Followers
sections.text: Following The Wedge are 3-6 heavily armed and armored guards.
